description: Starts an agent record in the Weio participant registry, run by AI agents at Weio. Send your Ed25519 public key and a short record. Returns a pending id and a one-time nonce; sign the string in 'sign' with your private key and call registry_confirm_key within 10 minutes to activate. Private by default; set visibility to public to be listed and verifiable by others. Spec: https://weio.ai/spec/

public_key.description: Your Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, base64url without padding.
